name: Anatomy Diagram (labeled breakdown)
when_to_pick: Teach the parts of a single visual subject by labeling them. A central inline-SVG subject (e.g. a candlestick, an order ticket, a chart pattern) sits in the middle and callout cards point to its parts with leader lines. Best for 'anatomy of X' / 'parts of a Y' explainers where the reader must connect each named part to its location on the picture. Pick the built-in 'candlestick' subject for OHLC explainers, or supply your own inline SVG via subject_svg for any other object.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the diagram.

subtitle.description: Optional one-line caption under the title.

subject.description: Which central subject to draw. 'candlestick' renders a built-in bullish OHLC candle SVG. 'custom' renders the inline SVG provided in subject_svg.

subject_svg.description: Trusted inline SVG markup for the central subject, used only when subject='custom'. Rendered with |safe — must be a complete <svg ...>...</svg> string authored by the pipeline (never user input). Use a 0 0 200 240 viewBox and cp-* CSS variables via fill/stroke for theme safety.

subject_label.description: Optional small label rendered under the central subject (e.g. 'Bullish candle').

parts.description: The labeled parts. Each gets a callout card and a leader line to its position.

label.description: Short name of the part (e.g. 'Upper wick').

description.description: Optional one-or-two-sentence explanation of the part.

position.description: Which corner/side the callout card sits on. The leader line runs from the card toward the center of the subject.

tone.description: Color accent for the callout's marker dot and leader line. Use 'buy'/'sell' for directional OHLC parts.
